title: GIRDER ROAD CORSA
notes: Exact ROAD-section CORSA page lists ¥7,999; sizes S (448 mm), M (459 mm), L (497 mm); T700+T800 'integrated' frame and fork, EPS molding, fully internal routing, press-fit BB, 12 mm thru-axles; T700+T800 integrated bar; 105 FC-R7100 52-36T 170 mm, R7120 2×12, R7120 hydraulic discs; in-house ceramic BB ('PF386 to T47 tool compatible'); YBN (YABON) 12-speed chain; 'CS-7100' 11-34T; silicone bar tape; alloy rims with bearing Center Lock disc hubs, 160 mm rotors front and rear; Maxxis M203 700C×28C; no saddle listed; weight 8.8 kg (basis not stated). Not the NEW 2025 CORSA (NEW2025/42.html, T47, 50 mm carbon wheels, ¥9,999). ROAD-section bikes share T700+T800 carbon and press-fit shells and do not share a frame with NEW 2025 bikes of the same name.
